rules.title: jev-core never learns about LSP
rules.text: The core answers questions about documents and knows nothing about a transport: no `lsp-types`, no `Uri`, no `tower-lsp`. `crates/jev-lsp` is the only place that knows a client exists, which is what lets `crates/jev` share the core. ARCHITECTURE §1.

judgement.question: Does this put LSP vocabulary into the core — an `lsp-types` type, a `Uri`, a transport — rather than a document, a question or an answer?

criteria.true: the core now depends on a name only a protocol client can supply
criteria.false: it is prose about the protocol, a test, or a local type that merely carries the name
